description: This file defines the PipelineFunctionParameterResolverFactory class, which provides factory methods for creating various parameter resolvers used in pipeline functions, such as resolving empty parameters, string parameters, or multiple parameters that can be string constants or placeholders.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionParameterResolverFactory
classes.description: A factory class that provides methods to create parameter resolvers for pipeline functions, supporting different parameter formats and validation.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionParameterResolverFactory.ParameterResolver
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing and resolving a specified number of parameters from given input strings, supporting string constants and placeholders.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionParameterResolverFactory.SingleParameterResolver
classes.description: A helper class to resolve a single parameter, allowing placeholders depending on configuration.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionParameterResolverFactory.EmptyParameterResolver
classes.description: A predicate implementation to check if a parameter string represents an empty parameter list.

methods.name: forEmptyParameters
methods.description: Returns a resolver that validates empty parameter lists.

methods.name: forStringParameter
methods.description: Returns a resolver that resolves a single string constant parameter.

methods.name: forStringOrPlaceholderParameter
methods.description: Returns a resolver that resolves a single parameter that can be either a string constant or a placeholder.

methods.name: forTripleStringOrPlaceholderParameter
methods.description: Returns a resolver that processes three parameters, each of which can be a string constant or a placeholder.
